aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed 11.1.5.1, 11.1.5.2 and 11.1.6 CHANGE TEAM and CRITICAL source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_112.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 235 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. Only 21 of the 39 scoped base units are newly accounted, because eighteen numbered items were already accounted, twelve in 11.1.5.1 and six in 11.1.6 with none in 11.1.5.2; that asymmetry was confirmed independently. 85 new facets remain pending. The authoring prompt wrongly guessed this scope was the IF and CASE constructs; the author read the pinned document, found the sections are CHANGE TEAM and CRITICAL, and registered what the source says, which the reviewer verified and recorded as correct behaviour. One blocking finding was raised and closed. C11TR-001 found the 11.1.5.2 p5 requirement that all active images of the new team execute the same CHANGE TEAM statement filed as a diagnostic rejection, when it is in fact a dynamic multi-image synchronization obligation on the program: a conforming processor is neither required to diagnose a violation nor generally able to, and no portable executable oracle exists, because observing divergence would require the timing, scheduling and interleaving evidence this project forbids. The facet was unimplementable in both directions; the requirement remains registered and only the unsupportable plan was removed. This establishes a project precedent that a facet may carry a diagnostic expectation only if a conforming processor is required to reject the program, and an executable oracle only if a conforming single-image program can portably observe the effect. The author then swept the whole packet against that test and produced a twenty-two row classification which reclassified eight further facets as unimplementable, including the CRITICAL one-image-at-a-time and mutual-exclusion facets, since a conforming program cannot portably observe that another image was excluded. The reviewer audited that sweep for over-correction as well, because an unobservability claim that is too broad is itself a defect, examining the team-restoration rows and the CRITICAL segment classification for local single-image observability; none was over-suppressed, nothing is missing from the table, and no facet could pass vacuously in a single-image run. A substantial fraction of this packet's facets are therefore recorded as unimplementable in the current observational regime rather than merely unwritten, and registering this source gives the suite no multi-image capability. No CHANGE TEAM or CRITICAL execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
